C1226.title: Shenzhen Proposes Heavy Fines for Big Data-Enabled Price Discrimination
keywords: Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Data Regulation
Shenzhen Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee
C1226.summary: In June 2021, the draft Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Data Regulation was released for public comment, granting natural persons the right to refuse user profiling and personalized recommendations. It proposed strict penalties for big data-enabled price discrimination, with fines starting at 50,000 yuan and serious cases facing fines up to 50 million yuan or 5% of the previous year's revenue.

references.title: Shenzhen Data Regulation Draft Opens for Public Comment
